article.title: Palestinian Elections: Gaza & West Bank youth launch independent list in rejection of factional politics
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: For the second time, a self-funded civil society list led by young Gazans is seeking a seat in the Palestinian Legislative Council, focusing on immediate hardships, like unemployment, healthcare, and shelter, rather than political ideology.
